kitchen.note: The kitchen mini PC: mic, speakers and NFC in one box. No rooms key, so its replies stay on its own speaker.

master.note: Mic-only Pi in the master closet. The wake ding stays on its little USB speaker; spoken replies and timer alarms go out the master bath speakers. alarm_volume is well above the reply volume of 20 on purpose - a reply is for someone standing there, an alarm has to carry over a running shower.
